cards.explanation: The answer is the Tent of Meeting. The LORD says, "The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it…" (Numbers 2:2). Six hundred thousand men and a whole lot of families, and every tent is arranged around one spot. Nobody has to ask where the middle is, friends.

The answer is False. The text says the Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting "…at a distance from it…" (Numbers 2:2). So nobody is pitching a tent against it, friends. They circle around it and leave room in between.

The answer is Judah. "On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard…" (Numbers 2:3). Issachar camps next to them, then Zebulun (Numbers 2:5, 7), and Judah's camp sets out first (Numbers 2:9). Sunrise side AND first out the door? I would've asked for the west side and a long nap.

The answer is first. The camp of Judah, 186,400 men in all, "…shall set out first." (Numbers 2:9). They camp on the east and they lead the way when Israel moves, friends. When the whole camp starts rolling, Judah is out front.

The answer is the camp of the Levites. "In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites." (Numbers 2:17). It isn't out front, and it isn't dragging at the back. The camps set out "…in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard." (Numbers 2:17). Everybody gets a spot, and the Tent gets the middle one.

The answer is True. The LORD says, "They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard." (Numbers 2:17). Nobody has to figure out a new arrangement on moving day, bakers. The way they camp is the way they march.

The answer is the north side. "On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard…" (Numbers 2:25). East, south and west are already handed out, so north is what's left. Dan, Asher and Naphtali fill it.

The answer is False. Dan does set out last (Numbers 2:31), but the Tent of Meeting travels "In the middle of the camps…" (Numbers 2:17). So the Tent isn't at the back at all, friends. Dan's camp is the one bringing up the rear.

The answer is False. The total of 603,550 is "The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions…" (Numbers 2:32), and the Levites aren't in it. "But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses." (Numbers 2:33). Over six hundred thousand men counted, and one whole tribe sits out of the number on purpose. That's a lot of counting, and I'd have lost my place around number forty.

The answer is that they do everything He commanded. "So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses…" (Numbers 2:34). Every tribe camped under its standard, and they set out the same way, each man with his clan and his family. All of it was followed, friends.
